name: Neuroscience PhD
detailsNote: The ILS deadline shown (December 1st, 2025) is for an earlier cycle and the direct-admission dates carry no year, so Fall 2027 is not confirmed. Fee and funding amounts are not stated on the pages checked.
summary: PhD in neuroscience at the University of Georgia, mostly entered through the Integrated Life Sciences program with lab rotations. Direct admission is possible in exceptional cases.

publishedDeadlines.label: Integrated Life Sciences (ILS) deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Page text: full consideration for financial support is given to applications received by the stated ILS deadline. This date is for an earlier cycle; confirm Fall 2027.

publishedDeadlines.label: Direct admission, domestic (fall)
publishedDeadlines.note: Published without a year. Direct admission applicants must contact the Neuroscience Program Office before applying.

timeline.interviews: Top domestic applicants are invited to visit the UGA campus in late January or early February; top international applicants have a Skype-based interview.

english.toefl: 80 overall with at least 20 on speaking and writing
english.note: IELTS with no single band below 6.0. International students may be required to show English proficiency and proof of finances. The page gives no new-scale TOEFL score.

documents: Integrated Life Sciences (ILS) or direct admission application
requirements.note: The page says no GRE scores are required, but they are accepted and considered if submitted. Official transcripts are required before matriculation.
